svg.title: Architectural Plan Diagram of a Traditional Almadraba de Buche Tuna Trap
svg.desc: Top-down schematic of a Strait of Gibraltar almadraba labyrinth net showing coastline, shoreward and seaward leader nets, entrance (boca), funneling chambers (cámara, buche, bordonal), and final capture chamber (copo) surrounded by artisanal boats.
svg.text: SPANISH ATLANTIC COAST (CÁDIZ — CONIL · BARBATE · ZAHARA · TARIFA)
Continental shelf trap-net set perpendicular to shore (1–3 km offshore)
Guides offshore schools toward the trap
Net floor raised by boats (La Levantá)
Schematic plan of an Andalusian almadraba de buche · Source: Adapted from Rodríguez-Roda (1964, Inv. Pesq. 25) & Florido del Corral (2013).
